description: This file defines a dialog plugin for CKEditor 4, specifically for inserting and editing hidden input fields within the editor. It handles dialog creation, content setup, and commitment, interacting with editor elements and their attributes.

methods.name: getModel
methods.description: Retrieves the model element representing the hidden field being edited, if present.

methods.name: onShow
methods.description: Prepares the dialog when it is opened, selecting the appropriate element within the editor.

methods.name: onOk
methods.description: Handles the logic when the user confirms the dialog, creating or replacing the hidden input element in the editor.
